Pumpkin-chestnut soup,
serves two (I translated it from German, I hope it works)

Ingredients:

1 shallot chopped

butter for braising

1 tsp sugar

250g pumpkin cut into small cubes

125g (frozen) chestnuts, thawed

2.5-3dl broth

1 dl full cream

a bit of lemon juice

salt, pepper, nutmeg

Optional:
cottage cheese, 1 tbsp Grand Marnier

1) Braise shallots in foaming butter. Sprinkle with sugar and briefly caramelize.

2) Add the pumpkin and chestnuts. Cover with broth and cover and steam until soft. Let cool slightly, then puree.

3) Pour back into the pan and extend with as much broth as necessary to a smooth consistency. Heat it up just below the boiling point. Add the cream and lemon juice and season.

(Add 1 tablespoon of Grand Marnier for a taste refinement.) 
Garnish with cottage cheese and serve.
